title: Gate entry carries persisted state, actor, timestamp, reason, and bypass level
action: Extend the workflow record's per-gate entry so an approval state is PERSISTED, not derived (per D3). Today the entry is default_gate_entry -> {approved: bool, approved_for_plan_rev: null|number} in workflow_store/record.rs (search for `fn default_gate_entry`, near line 69). Add five fields to the entry: `state` (one of "pending", "approved", "rejected"), `actor` (one of "user", "auto", or null when never set), `at` (ISO timestamp or null), `reason` (string or null), and `bypass_level` (one of "off", "normal", "full", "total", or null) — bypass_level and reason are required by D2 so an auto-approval records WHY it did not stop. Reject an unknown `state` or `actor` value with a typed error, mirroring the existing WORKFLOW_MISSING/WORKFLOW_CORRUPT discipline rather than defaulting silently. Keep the existing `approved: bool` on the entry and keep it EQUAL to (state == "approved") — the plan's additive approach depends on this, because 37 call sites read the boolean. FOUR paths author a gate entry and every one of them must set the new fields or they desync on first use: (1) `default_gate_entry` in workflow_store/record.rs (~line 69) and `merge_gates` (~line 89-117) which spreads a base entry and overlays a patch; (2) `gates_patch_from_record` in workflow_store/handoff.rs (~line 514-534) — THIS is the real entry author for `bee state gate`: it builds each entry from an empty map and inserts only `approved` plus the rev stamp, so a stale `state` would survive while `approved` flips; (3) `legacy_gates_to_workflow_gates` in state_group/feature.rs (~line 319-332), which hardcodes {approved, approved_for_plan_rev: null} and is called from feature.rs near lines 438 and 462; (4) the `default_gates()` resets at state_group/policy.rs near lines 390 and 506. A record written by the OLD shape (no `state` field) must still read correctly, deriving `state` from the existing boolean, so an existing repo never mis-gates on upgrade. Do NOT change workflow_gates_to_approved_gates in workflow_store/projections.rs: the PROJECTED boolean is `is_approved && rev_effective` on purpose, so after `plan-rev bump` the record stays approved:true while the projection reads false. That divergence is intended plan-rev invalidation and must be asserted as intended, never repaired.

truths: A gate entry written by any of the four authoring paths has state, actor, at, reason, and bypass_level present
For every entry after every write path, the entry's approved boolean equals (state == "approved")
An entry written in the old shape, with no state field, reads back with state derived from its approved boolean
An unknown state or actor value refuses with a typed error and writes nothing
After plan-rev bump the record entry stays approved:true while the projected approved_gates boolean reads false, asserted as intended behavior

artifacts.substantive: default_gate_entry and merge_gates carry the five new fields with validation, no TODO stubs
tests covering all four authoring paths, legacy-shape read, invalid-value refusal, and the intended plan-rev divergence

key_links: gates_patch_from_record writes state and approved together so merge_gates cannot leave them disagreeing
legacy_gates_to_workflow_gates emits the new fields instead of dropping them
prohibitions: No change to workflow_gates_to_approved_gates in projections.rs
No change to the five cell status values
No removal of the approved boolean from the entry
No change to GATE_ALLOWED_PREFIXES — that belongs to slice 2
